decision: L-Space retains fail-closed Google email admission for operators and independently admits a Discord-authenticated reader only while Discord reports that reader as a non-pending member of the configured Turntide Island guild holding the exact configured islander role ID.

trustBoundary.authentication: Discord OAuth 2.0 authorization-code grant with state and S256 PKCE
trustBoundary.excludedScope: guilds — L-Space does not need or receive the reader's other guild memberships
trustBoundary.authorization: GET /users/@me/guilds/{guild.id}/member followed by exact membership of TURNTIDE_ISLANDER_ROLE_ID in the returned role snowflakes
trustBoundary.revalidation: before every protected response; no durable role snapshot grants access
trustBoundary.failurePolicy: missing configuration, missing scope, absent membership, pending membership, missing role, token failure, rate limit, malformed response, or Discord outage all deny protected content
trustBoundary.rateLimitPolicy: Discord Retry-After is persisted per session; protected requests receive fail-closed HTTP 503 with Retry-After instead of being misreported as signed out
trustBoundary.refreshConcurrency: optimistic authorization_version updates reload the winning rotated token when concurrent requests race a refresh

sessionCustody.browser: random opaque HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax bearer
sessionCustody.database: SHA-256 hash of browser bearer plus AES-GCM-encrypted Discord access and refresh tokens
sessionCustody.encryptionKey: derived from the Worker SESSION_SECRET with a domain-separated context
sessionCustody.logout: delete local D1 session, clear browser cookies, and request Discord token revocation
sessionCustody.retention: a daily bounded Worker trigger revokes and deletes expired Discord sessions
sessionCustody.reviewIdentity: SHA-256 of the provider-qualified Discord subject; raw Discord IDs do not enter VaultMaze review rows

deployment.cloudflareAccess: The legacy Cloudflare Access application must be removed or unscoped before either first-party login path can run.
